about: Eyeballed false positives of find-filled-water.py: AHN's DTM interpolates over open water (ponds, dock edges), so a candidate containing one of these points is dropped. Evidence: PDOK luchtfoto crops in docs/reports/land-mask-gaps-20261109/.

rejects.why: Zuidoost pond in the park (DTM +5.8 m NAP is interpolated from the banks); BGT calls the pond begroeid terrain
drained pond inside the A9/A2 interchange loop, still holds water (cand-montage-other-confirmed.jpg, top right)
open water at the Westpoort quay (DTM +1.7 m interpolated beside the bank); BGT agrees it is water (cand-noord-52.428.jpg)
